Flat vector-like clean ink outlines and restrained cel shading matching input mascot, never photorealistic or 3D. Sharp corners on UI and cards. SOLID OPAQUE background #F5F3EE edge to edge, never transparent or checkerboard. Palette #E6501F orange for emphasis/blazer, #14181C charcoal, #121B23/#0D1318 dark panels, #ECEDE7 foreground lines, #5B6570 secondary only. Natural mascot skin tone preserved. No green/yellow UI, no decorative gradients, glow, glass, stock look, invented statistics or extra unrequested text. Generous negative space. Input references: mascot when supplied is identity/style only, preserve exact face, proportions, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, orange blazer with dark S lapel pin, blue-grey blouse, charcoal trousers and heels. Brand image is Sthuthi logo reference: include only its modest geometric orange/charcoal S mark in one corner, preserve its mark and omit its checkerboard. Tool logo reference when supplied: include small recognizable logo within tool screen, authentic logo colors allowed ONLY within logo. No implied endorsement or partnership. Asset: inline supporting PNG 1000x750, 4:3 aspect ratio. Use requested labels legibly, no extra text. Scene: Same mascot kneeling beside a large wall-mounted multi-file diff, tracing an orange incorrect context connection with a pen while glancing back at the prompt panel. New investigative expression/pose, no clipboard. Small supplied Cursor logo. Short labels exactly 'PROMPT', 'CONTEXT', 'DIFF'.
images.editPrompt: Edit the supplied PNG only. Replace green diff blocks/lines with #5B6570 and #ECEDE7. Preserve exact mascot identity, kneeling pose, logos, orange trace and labels. No green anywhere. Final 4:3 PNG; opaque paper #F5F3EE background, clean flat vector/cel shading, no decorative gradient or glow. Preserve all other elements exactly.

images.name: featured
images.alt: The Sthuthi guide sets Claude Code permissions and checks a repository change during a practical assessment.
images.scene: Same mascot in a new side-on full-body pose, standing with one arm extending to set a permission switch on a wall terminal while the other pulls a scoped task sheet into a repository boundary. Alert expression. NOT clipboard, NOT laptop, NOT hand at chin. Small real supplied Claude Code logo on terminal. Main headline exactly 'SET THE SCOPE.' smaller line exactly 'Then check the diff.' Permission gate discreetly represents access restrictions, no misleading official credential seal.
